```{r setup, results='hide', message=FALSE}
## load packages:
library(data.table)
library(arsenal)
library(CRP)

source("20_functions/source_dir.R")
source_dir("20_functions")
```

## Read raw BACS data

```{r}
dtbacs <- readRDS(file = "02_data_derived/bacs_raw.rds")
dtbacs <- dtbacs[n_target == 0]
```

Required columns and `part`s:
```{r}
required_col <- c("ID", "trt", "value", "part")
required_part <- 
  c("dansk", "farveblind", "venstrehand", "mem1", "mem2", "mem3", 
    "mem4", "mem5", "talsekv_1", "talsekv_2", "talsekv_3", "talsekv_4", 
    "talsekv_5", "talsekv_6", "talsekv_7", "talsekv_total", "token_bord", 
    "token_beholder", "token_fejl", "token_total", "ordmob", "bogstavmob_f", 
    "bogstavmob_s", "symnr", "tol")
stopifnot(is.data.table(dtbacs))
test_required(required_col, names(dtbacs))
test_required(required_part, dtbacs[, unique(part)])
```

Cast `dtbacs` to wide format and show missing values:
```{r}
dbacs <- dcast(dtbacs, ID + trt ~ part, value.var = "value")
show_na(dbacs)
```

Coerce categorical variables to factors:
```{r}
dbacs[, f_dansk := factor(fifelse(dansk == 0, "Nej", "Ja"))]
dbacs[, f_farveblind := factor(fifelse(farveblind == 0, "Nej", "Ja"))]
dbacs[, f_venstrehand := factor(fifelse(venstrehand == 0, "Nej", "Ja"))]
dbacs[, `:=`(dansk       = NULL,
             farveblind  = NULL,
             venstrehand = NULL)]
```

Set parameters:
```{r}
# Variables names in bacs:
nm <- names(dbacs)

# Names for fluency and memory sub-items:
#   PSYCH-FLAME: c("semantic", "letter_s", "letter_f")
nm_fluency <- c("ordmob", "bogstavmob_s", "bogstavmob_f")
nm_verbmem <- getgrep("^mem", nm)

# Sub items:
#   PSYCH-FLAME names:
#   measure_vars <- 
#     c("verbalmem1", "verbalmem2", "verbalmem3", "verbalmem4", "verbalmem5", 
#       "digitseq", "token", "semantic", "letter_s", "letter_f", "coding", "tower")
sub_items <- 
  c(nm_verbmem, "talsekv_total", "token_total", nm_fluency, "symnr", "tol")

# Items for checking missingness:
#   PSYCH-FLAME items:
#   items <- c("digitseq", "token", "coding", "tower", "miss_verbmem", "miss_fluency")
miss_items <- c("talsekv_total", "token_total", "symnr", "tol", "miss_verbmem", 
                "miss_fluency")

# Items:
#   PSYCH-FLAME names:
#   measure_vars <- 
#     c("verbmem", "digitseq", "token", "fluency", "coding", "tower")
items <- 
  c("verbmem", "talsekv_total", "token_total", "fluency", "symnr", "tol")

# Identify treatment levels:  
trt_levs <- get_trt_levs(dbacs)
ref_trt_lev <- trt_levs[1] |> unname()
dexa_trt_lev <- trt_levs[2] |> unname()
```

## Handle missingness

1. Verbal memory is set to `NA` if a subject has 3 or more missing values among the verbal memory sub-scores
1. Fluency is set to `NA` if a subject has 2 or more missing values among the verbal fluency sub-scores

```{r}
# number of missing sub-scores in verbal memory:
dbacs[, miss_verbmem := rowSums(is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = nm_verbmem]
# dbacs[, .N, miss_verbmem]
dbacs[miss_verbmem >= 3, miss_verbmem := NA]
# dbacs[, .N, miss_verbmem]

# number of missing sub-scores in verbal fluency:
dbacs[, miss_fluency := rowSums(is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = nm_fluency]
dbacs[miss_fluency >= 2, miss_fluency := NA]
# dbacs[, .N, miss_fluency]
```

We only use BACS scores if at most 1 item is missing. This is recorded in the variable `use_bacs`: 
```{r}
stopifnot(all(miss_items %in% names(dbacs)))
dbacs[, nmiss_bacs := rowSums(is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = miss_items]
# dbacs[, .N, nmiss_bacs]
dbacs[, use_bacs := ifelse(nmiss_bacs <= 1, "yes", "no")]
# dbacs[, .N, keyby=.(nmiss_bacs, use_bacs)]
```

## Tabulate raw BACS data

```{r results='asis'}
allvar <- setDiff(names(dbacs), c("ID", "trt"))
form <- reformulate(allvar, "trt")

ctr <- tableby.control(numeric.stats = c("Nmiss", "meansd", "medianrange"),
                       cat.stats = c("Nmiss", "countpct"),
                       stats.labels=list(Nmiss = "Missing", Nmiss2 = "Missing",
                                         meansd = "Mean (SD)", range = "Range",
                                         medianrange = "Median (Range)",
                                         gmeansd = "Geom Mean (Geom SD)"),
                       chisq.correct = FALSE, digits = 1, test.always = FALSE)

tab <- tableby(form, data=dbacs, control=ctr, test=FALSE)

if(interactive()) 
  summary(tab, text = TRUE, term.name = TRUE, test=FALSE) 
if(!interactive()) 
  summary(tab, term.name = TRUE, test=FALSE)
```

## Standardized scores for the control group

### First, get standardized scores for verbal memory and fluency items

```{r}
stopifnot(all(sub_items %in% names(dbacs)))
dbacs2 <- melt(dbacs[use_bacs == "yes"], id.vars = c("ID", "trt"), 
               measure.vars = sub_items,
               variable.name = "test", value.name = "n_raw")
dbacs2

# Compute standardized scores for control group:
dbacs_ctr <- dbacs2[trt == ref_trt_lev & !is.na(n_raw)]
dbacs_ctr <- dbacs_ctr[, .(n_mean_ctr = mean(n_raw), 
                           n_sd_ctr = sd(n_raw)), test]
dbacs_ctr
```

Aggregate standardized scores for verbal memory and fluency items
```{r}
dbacs2 <- merge(dbacs2, dbacs_ctr, by="test")
dbacs2[, n_std := (n_raw - n_mean_ctr) / n_sd_ctr]

# Aggregate scores for verbal memory and fluency:
dbacs3 <- dcast(dbacs2, ID + trt ~ test, value.var = "n_std")
dbacs3[, verbmem := rowMeans(.SD, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = nm_verbmem]
# sapply(dbacs3, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
# dbacs3[is.na(verbmem)]
dbacs3[, fluency := rowMeans(.SD, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = nm_fluency]
# cbind(sapply(dbacs3, function(x) sum(is.na(x))))
```

### Second, get standardized scores for all main items

Compute standardized scores for control (placebo) group:
```{r}
stopifnot(all(items %in% names(dbacs3)))
dbacs4 <- melt(dbacs3, id.vars = c("ID", "trt"), 
               measure.vars = items,
               variable.name = "test", value.name = "n_raw2")

# Compute standardized scores for control group:
dbacs_ctr2 <- dbacs4[trt == ref_trt_lev & !is.na(n_raw2)]
dbacs_ctr2 <- dbacs_ctr2[, .(n_mean_ctr = mean(n_raw2), 
                             n_sd_ctr = sd(n_raw2)), test]
dbacs_ctr2
```


## Compute standardized BACS score for all subjects

Compute standardized score for all subjects-by-items:
```{r}
dbacs4 <- merge(dbacs4, dbacs_ctr2, by = "test", all.x = TRUE)
dbacs4[, n_std := (n_raw2 - n_mean_ctr) / n_sd_ctr]
# cbind(sapply(dbacs4, function(x) sum(is.na(x))))
dbacs4
```

Compute the average standardized score for each subject by averaging over items:
```{r}
dbacs5 <- dbacs4[, .(n_bacs = mean(n_std, na.rm = TRUE)), .(ID, trt)]
```

Make dataset including all subjects:
```{r}
dbacs6 <- merge(dbacs[, .(ID, trt, f_dansk, f_farveblind, f_venstrehand)], 
                dbacs5, by=c("ID", "trt"), all.x = TRUE)
dbacs6
```

Save final BACS dataset to file:
```{r}
saveRDS(dbacs6, file = "02_data_derived/bacs_derived.rds")
```

## Tabulate derived BACS data

```{r results='asis'}
allvar <- setDiff(names(dbacs6), c("ID", "trt"))
form <- reformulate(allvar, "trt")

tab <- tableby(form, data=dbacs6, control=ctr, test=FALSE)

if(interactive()) 
  summary(tab, text = TRUE, term.name = TRUE, test=FALSE) 
if(!interactive()) 
  summary(tab, term.name = TRUE, test=FALSE)
```
